items.title: [DC] snorlax01@🔸guides: GLotan   Mob Waves w/ base Ramona - Equip GLotan Posse - Keyflare Rouse GLotan
items.summary:
GLotan 

Mob Waves w/ base Ramona
- Equip GLotan Posse
- Keyflare Rouse GLotan 
- Play GLotan Rouse 
- Use Cetus-Devouring Storm on base Ramona 
- L if no Long Blade, play Defense to Draw it
- L or use base Ramona Exalt to obtain it from Draw / Discard Pile
- Play Strikes to reduce the Cost of Long Blade, ideally Short Blade
- Play Long Blade last  

Mob Waves w/ Cassiah
Version 1
- Keyflare Rouse GLotan 
- If no Long Blade / Short Blade
- Use The Mountain's Resolve on GLotan 
- L if you still do not have Long Blade, play Defense to Draw it out 
 - if you can, play Telekinesis while Ultra Space is empty
- L or use Telekinesis to grab Short Blade from the Ultra Space
- Play whatever Strikes that you have available, (ideally Short Blade)
- Play Long Blade at the very end 

Version 2
- Keyflare Rouse GLotan 
- If you do have Long Blade (or Defense) / Short Blade
- Use The Mountain's Resolve on Cassiah to obtain Telekinesis 
- L if you do not have Long Blade, play Defense to Draw it out 
 - Ideally pllay Telekinesis while Ultra Space is empty
- L or use Telekinesis to grab Short Blade from the Ultra Space
- Play whatever Strikes that you have available, (ideally Short Blade)
- Play Long Blade at the very end 

Exalt 
- Play Short Blade 3x
- L once marked Gold, play Short Blade into Long Blade to combine and fuse into Whalefall
- L which in Turn, would also unlock your Exalt
- If incapable of using Exalt (or you want to use OE instead,) play Deadly Duel to use the Aliemus of her Allies to Battery herself
- Use Exalt / OE, only when you are guaranteed to die due to a lot of Damage

PChaos Posse
- Whenever possible, prioritize  Triple Posse (Triphase Relevation) over Double-Play (Dual Recurrence) 
- Prioritize Damage Buffs > Arith > Search > Aliemus > Draw
- To generate Keyflare, play as much Cards as possible from your Awakeners for the first time in each Turn

items.title: A critically underrated gem.
items.summary:
Morimens is a gem. I’d go as far to say it’s one of the best gacha games out there for gacha gamers who want something more than just run-of-the-mill waifu collectors.

This game is hard as nails. It has countless grotesque, terrifying, Lovecraftian scenes. The number of people who beat the story’s hard mode is in the double digits. It will grind you up to dust and spit you out.

Yet, I keep coming back to it like a drug.

It’s a card battler that plays a lot like Slay the Spire. It has a steampunk aesthetic. So why is it so addictive?

It’s simple- it’s a roguelite that you have endless variety with, with so many bosses and lovely gimmicks. When you have a boss standing over you with over a thousand health and an attack that can one-shot you, you only have one option- see what you can do to get out of this.

If you want a hidden gem that’s so satisfying to play, Morimens won’t disappoint.

items.summary: まずこのゲームのいいところをいくつか紹介します。 世界観がいい。 戦闘が面白くて何分も悩むくらい難しいから飽きない。報酬の配布や課金要素が優しい。 物語にキャラの声がないこととか、一部のサウンドが安っぽいとか…そういう批判の声もありますが、理解してほしいのはゲームを作ったスタジオが一流じゃないということです。とても限られた予算をうまく活用してここまでいいゲームを作り上げられるのは奇跡って呼びたいくらいすごいと思う。 ガチャゲームといえば、課金をある程度強要するものですから、課金要素がいかに体験を左右させるかが大事だと思います。課金しないとまともに楽しめないゲームなら最初から有料にすればいいのに！って思います。 ホ○バースなどの超大金持ちで超一流運営でさえそういった「課金を強要」する部分がイライラするほど仕込まれているのに、名前がほぼ知られていない小さなスタジオがよし！ホラーとローグライクを組み合わせたガチャ作るぞ！って言ってここまでいいもの作れるとか最高かよ。おれ1人で大量課金できるならしたい…
